title: The Paired Silence Discipline
summary: The school course in holding two silences side by side and ending a fight with the school's joined hush.

title: The Dual-Track Void Crown
summary: The school's high course of two tracks of void that meet at the crown in a single world-emptying close.

title: The Gale-Sworn Hush Canon
summary: The school canon of a hush sworn to the wind that stands against every gale and answers it with a stillness no storm can cross.

title: The Oath Beneath the Open Void
summary: The school's deepest oath sworn to the void itself and loosed from far below as a rising and silent sinking of all things.
